[LV1][LV2][LV3] When Attacks: You may exhaust one of your spirits or nexuses to discard cards from the top of your opponent's deck equal to the cost of that card. When a magic card is discarded this way, refresh this spirit.
[LV2][LV3] During Opponent's Attack Step: At the start of the step, if your opponent has 15 or more cards in their trash, you may summon a Golem spirit card from your hand without paying its cost.
